title: Aise Waiso se pyaar mat keejo
body:
Aise waiso se pyaar mat keejo..(2)
Ye khata baar baar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhod deta hai saath mushkil me..(2)
Shaikh par inhesaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai nuseri bhi dushmane haider..(2)
Dosto me shumaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaan atki hai teri duniya me..(2)
Jaan par jaanesaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Gar hai ya laytani ka dawedaar..(2)
Waqt e nusrat faraar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab pukare tujhe imaam e zamaa..(2)
Sar ko gardan pa baar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho jo maqrooz aale at’har ke..(2)
Unse bilkul udhaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae muqassil ali ka behre madad..(2)
Qabr me intezaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jisse naaraaz ho ali o batool..(2)
Wo rawish ikhteyaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tang seene pa hai jo matam ke..(2)
Fisq se daaghdaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai hu mohtaaj ghair ka tere..(2)
Aisa parwardigaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo saza ho lahad me de lijo..(2)
Hashr me sharmsaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo jo bhaage ohod se ab unka..(2)
Ae habeeb aitbaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Juz ali baab e fath e khaibar me..(2)
Ghair ka intezaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Abre aayat kisi munafiq se..(2)
Sahibe zulfiqaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Majlise mehfile hai aine ishq..(2)
Ishq ko kaarobaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sibte jafar hai tere darr ka gada..(2)
Dar bardar isko khaar mat keejo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Mehfil hai ehle tawalla ki mehfil, yaha sirf hogi mohabbat ki baatein
Nafee ghair ki hai mohabbat ka hissa, na samjhe ise koi nafrat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Siwae nabi aur aale nabi ke, kiya kisne kab hai shifa’at ka waada
jise haqne baksha hai haqqe shifa’at, wohi to karega shifa’at ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Yahi to madare wujudo adam hai, yahi malike salsabeelo iram hai
Jise hai nabi o ali se mohabbat, use zeb deti hai jannat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ba kaaba wiladat, ba masjid shahadat, nabi se mawakha to Zahra se nisbat
ali ke hai ye imteyazi fazael, abas hai kisi se fazeelat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Badha shehr se kaun sakta hai darr ko, mohammad madina ali baab uska
Ilaqa nahi ilm o hiqmat se jinko, wahi kar rahe jihalat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Padi thi jo saccho ki haq ko zarurat, faqad panjetan kaam aaye the haq ke
Tumhara na siddiqo siddiqa koi, to karte ho kyu tum sadaqat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Hunain o ohod ho ya khandak ya khaibar, tike hi nahi jo kisi maareke me
lade hi nahi jo kabhi haq ki khatir, na kar unki farzi shaja’at ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghaneemat ki mat maar kar jo ghani bangae the, tahi dast khaibar se pehle
na dilwa sake haqqe zehra jo unse, to karte ho tum kyu sakhawat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi jiske maula, ali uske maula, ye chhota sa ek mas’ala tum na samjhe
tumhari samajh me jo maula na aaye, to kyu kar rahe ho wilayat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Na ajre risalat adaa kar rahe ho, na haqqe mawaddat adaa kar rahe ho
amal to tumhara hai ghairo ke jaisa, yuhi kar rahe ho bara’at ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jamal neherwaan aur siffin o qatle abuzar saqeefa fidak aur khaibar
ali ki sharafat ki baatein hai inme, to ghairo ke sharr aur aafat ki baatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda ke nahi waledain o aizza, na aulad o zauja na roti na kapda
nusairi ko samjhaiye sibte jafar, wo kyu kar raha hai himaqat ki baatein
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
